escalations.title: JavaScript Injection via AST Type Confusion
escalations.exploit_scenario: User-controlled data passed to Handlebars template rendering allows arbitrary JavaScript execution in the backend server process.
escalations.fix: Update handlebars to >=4.7.9; audit all template render call sites for user-controlled input.

escalations.title: Arbitrary Code Execution via prototype pollution
escalations.exploit_scenario: Malformed protobuf message injected into the orchestrator pipeline triggers prototype pollution leading to arbitrary code execution. Orchestrator compromise has platform-wide blast radius.

p1_findings.title: Traceability enforcer targets Plans/ not Specifications/
p1_findings.detail: The verification gate scans only Plans/self-judging-workflow/requirements.md (13 FR-WF-* IDs). Canonical 84+ FRs in Specifications/ are never checked. All agents get false 'TRACEABILITY PASSED' confidence.
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Agent team implements a feature, gate reports PASSED, commits code with zero traceability to formal specs.
p1_findings.recommendation: Update traceability-enforcer.py to scan Specifications/ for FR-XXX IDs, or mark Specifications/ docs as SUPERSEDED and update CLAUDE.md to document the canonical requirements source.

p1_findings.title: dev-workflow-platform.md describes 84 unimplemented FRs — spec/code mismatch
p1_findings.detail: Spec defines FR-001–FR-069 for a SQLite-backed platform. Zero source files implement these. The codebase pivoted to an in-memory workflow engine without archiving this spec.
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: New agent reads Specifications/ as truth per CLAUDE.md instruction and implements SQLite tables and entities that conflict with existing Source/ codebase.
p1_findings.recommendation: Mark dev-workflow-platform.md as status: SUPERSEDED at document top. Document the pivot to the current workflow engine.

p1_findings.title: Handlebars — JavaScript Injection via AST Type Confusion
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: User-controlled data passed to Handlebars rendering allows arbitrary JavaScript execution in the backend server process.
p1_findings.recommendation: Update handlebars to >=4.7.9. Audit all template render call sites.

p1_findings.title: Vitest — Path Traversal / Arbitrary File Read via @vitest/mocker
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Maliciously-crafted test file or mock path reads arbitrary files from CI runner filesystem, including .env files and secrets.
p1_findings.recommendation: Update vitest to >=5.0.0 (semver major — review breaking changes before updating).

p1_findings.title: Protobufjs — Arbitrary Code Execution
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Malformed protobuf message injected into orchestrator triggers prototype pollution leading to arbitrary code execution with platform-wide blast radius.

p2_findings.title: tiered-merge-pipeline.md has zero implementation
